subject.title: Google Chat: Add threaded reply support + receive all messages in spaces

question: Should the official Google Chat plugin add opt-in all-Space-message ingestion, and should that use Workspace Events with user OAuth or app authentication/admin approval instead of the current service-account HTTP webhook model?
rationale: Source review proves the missing capability, but accepting it changes which Space messages reach OpenClaw, what credentials and scopes are stored, and how subscription lifecycle and consent work.

options.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

options.title: Defer All-Message Ingestion
options.body: Document Google Chat as webhook/@mention-only for now and revisit if maintainers are ready to sponsor the broader data-visibility surface.

options.title: Split Threading From Ingestion
options.body: Let focused thread-reply/session work proceed separately while this issue remains the security/product decision for all-message ingestion.

recommendation.title: Design Opt-In Workspace Events Mode
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a Google Chat plugin design covering scopes, subscription lifecycle, consent, allowlists, docs, tests, and live Google Chat proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current routing signal from prior review on this issue and sustained Google Chat API/docs/security-boundary history.
